keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Kasper Høgh (Celtic).
Delay in match because of an injury Stopira (Torreense).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Own Goal by Javi Vázquez, Torreense. Torreense 0, Celtic 1.
Goal! Torreense 1, Celtic 1. Dany Jean (Torreense) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Jota (Celtic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Javi Vázquez (Torreense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Celtic. Cameron Carter-Vickers replaces Dane Murray.
Substitution, Celtic. Oliver Sørensen replaces Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain.
Substitution, Celtic. Camilo Durán replaces Kasper Høgh.
Mohamed Ali Diadie (Torreense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Torreense. Amine Oudrhiri replaces Stopira.
Substitution, Torreense. André Simões replaces João Marques.
Jonathan Mutombo (Torreense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Celtic. James Forrest replaces Jota.
Substitution, Torreense. Luis Quintero replaces Manu Pozo.
Substitution, Torreense. David Bruno replaces Jonathan Mutombo.
Substitution, Celtic. Sebastian Tounekti replaces Yang Hyun-Jun.
Goal! Torreense 1, Celtic 2. Camilo Durán (Celtic) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by James Forrest with a cross.
Substitution, Torreense. Karem Zoabi replaces Alejandro Alfaro.
Second Half ends, Torreense 1, Celtic 2.
